text.description_html:
Brass Accents D07-L150X-MKZ, Drop Tail Mackenzie Door Lever with Round Rose

The Mackenzie Lever with Traditional Rose is done in the contemporary style in the early 20th century, but reflects the more romantic approach of the neo-French look while offering the simplicity craved by the federal American Period.

Specifications for the Brass Accents D07-L150X-MKZ Traditional Rose with Mackenzie Lever:

  • Lever Length: 4-3/8"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Backset: 2"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim on one side of the door. It does not latch and does not lock.
  • Double Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim on both sides of the door. They do not latch and do not lock
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. The lock is activated by a push button while turning the inside lever releases the lock. It can be opened from the outside with a small tool.

Sold Individually.
